summary: Sequoia Arc appears active as Sequoia's bi-annual open call and Arc Intensive for pre-seed/seed founders, but the only public application deadline currently shown is the past Fall '25 deadline. No current 2026 application window or cohort dates were found on the official pages, so no event should be merged yet.

sources.title: Get started with Sequoia
sources.supports: States Arc is Sequoia's bi-annual open call for pre-seed and seed stage founders; says Spring '25 applications are closed and Fall '25 open call closed Sunday, August 17 at 11:59 pm PT; says founders can sign up to be notified when the next call opens.

sources.title: Get started with Sequoia
sources.supports: Describes the Arc Intensive as four days for Sequoia pre-seed and seed founders, with small cohorts of about 10 companies, 1:1 time with Sequoia, company-building frameworks, partner/operator support, Ampersand resources, and 200+ benefits including cloud and AI credits.

notes: Today is 2026-06-09, so the published Fall '25 application deadline is stale and should not be presented as a current opportunity.
Official pages indicate a continuing notification/signup flow, but they do not publish the next 2026 application open date, close date, program start, program end, demo day, or location.
No proposed_event is returned because current dates are not public; keep or update the existing 2025 event only if the catalog intentionally includes past cohorts.
